summary_brief: 2026年3月22日，AI Agent生态迎来三大突破性进展：**浏览器自主交互能力成熟化**（gptme、Playwright推进ARIA快照与状态保持式浏览）、**可观测性平台向AI辅助调试演进**（Phoenix引入Agent上下文侧边栏与交互式Bash执行）、**CLI工具作为LLM提供商实现互操作性统一**（Claude Code、Codex CLI被整合为统一后端）。同时，**MCP协议扩张**、**类型安全改进**、**模块化重构**三大延续趋势继续深化，共同指向Agent从被动响应向主动执行、从碎片化工具向互操作生态、从实验性向生产级的关键转型。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 浏览器自主交互能力成熟化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同时推进 AI Agent 的浏览器交互能力，从 ARIA 无障碍快照、状态保持式浏览到交互式页面操作，标志着 AI Agent 正从被动响应向主动网页任务执行演进，是自主 AI 系统的关键里程碑。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议生态快速扩张：资源访问与服务器覆盖增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: MCP (Model Context Protocol) 正在成为 AI 模型与外部世界交互的标准协议，资源访问 API 的扩展和 Phoenix 等可观测性平台的深度集成，将加速 AI Agent 与企业工具链的融合。

engineering_signals.title: 可观测性平台向 AI 辅助调试演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Phoenix 引入 AI Agent 上下文侧边栏和交互式 Bash 工具执行，标志着可观测性平台从被动数据展示向主动 AI 辅助排障转变，大幅降低调试复杂度并提升开发效率。

engineering_signals.title: CLI 工具作为 LLM 提供商：AI 编程生态互操作性整合
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code、Codex CLI 等 AI 编程助手正被整合为统一的 LLM 后端，支持 OAuth 认证和多种 API 配置，标志着碎片化的 AI 编程工具正在走向互操作性统一。

engineering_signals.title: 类型安全工程化改进形成跨项目共识
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 项目中多个 PR 系统性消除 type: ignore 注释，采用 cast()、Literal、assert 等类型安全替代方案，展示了 AI 项目从快速迭代向工程化成熟转型的最佳实践模式。

engineering_signals.title: 模块化重构：大型单体文件拆分为模块化包
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 展示了一套可复用的模块化重构模式：将 1000+ 行的单体文件拆分为聚焦的模块包，同时通过 re-exports 保持完全向后兼容，为快速成长的 AI 项目提供了可维护性升级的参考路径。

engineering_signals.title: LLM API 成本优化：动态/静态上下文分离提升缓存命中率
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 通过策略性地排序 prompt 内容以最大化 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等提供商的前缀缓存效率，展示了在生产环境中降低 LLM API 成本和延迟的实用模式。

engineering_signals.title: AI 记忆层集成扩展：向量数据库与沙箱环境
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Mem0 通过集成 Turbopuffer 向量数据库和 NemoClaw 沙箱插件，扩展了 AI 记忆系统的存储选项和工具链能力，为构建持久化记忆的 AI Agent 提供了更完善的基础设施。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 安全性与可控性增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Hook 系统支持 'ask' 决策允许工具执行前的用户确认，向量数据库添加输入验证提前捕获错误，这些改进共同提升了 AI Agent 在生产环境中的安全性和可调试性。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 评估框架完善化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 添加模型对比排行榜、外部评估规范加载和评估列表功能，为 AI Agent 的性能评估和基准测试提供了更完善的工具链，是 AI Agent 走向生产化的关键基础设施。

release_signals.title: Phoenix AI Agent 与交互式调试
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入了 AI Agent 上下文侧边栏和浏览器端 Bash 工具执行能力，标志着可观测性平台正从被动数据展示向主动 AI 辅助调试和交互式排障演进。

release_signals.title: Phoenix CLI 功能扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 `spans` 命令支持获取和过滤 spans 数据，以及 `px docs fetch` 功能，极大地增强了命令行环境下的数据查询和文档获取工作流。

release_signals.title: Vercel 微前端分组管理
release_signals.why_it_matters: CLI 新增对微前端组的创建、删除和修改能力，为采用微前端架构的大型团队提供了更细粒度的组织和管理抽象层。

release_signals.title: AI 模型 SDK 生态快速迭代
release_signals.why_it_matters: Fabric 同步更新了 Anthropic SDK (v1.27.1) 和 Ollama (v0.18.2) 等核心依赖，并移除了过时的 Claude 4 模型别名，反映了 AI 基础设施层正在快速适配最新的模型能力。

release_signals.title: 可观测性 Onboarding 体验增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: Phoenix 为 LangChain、OpenAI、Anthropic、Mastra 和 Bedrock 等主流框架添加了 TypeScript 和 Python 的集成代码片段，显著降低了新用户的接入门槛。

signals.topic: Sub-agent communication failures and message mishandling

signals.review_reason: Multiple users report sub-agent coordination failures. Main agent cannot receive/use sub-agent results properly. This breaks multi-agent workflows and parallel agent patterns which are core SDK use cases.

source_issues.title: structured_output not present in the ResultMessage block if certain tool calls happen after StructuredOutput block

signals.topic: Third-party provider compatibility breaks (Bedrock, Anthropic-compatible)
signals.summary: SDK features that work with Anthropic API break on AWS Bedrock and other Anthropic-compatible providers due to strict schema validation or parameter handling differences. Includes eager_input_streaming and thinking parameter issues.
signals.review_reason: Users deploying on AWS Bedrock or other Anthropic-compatible providers experience hard failures. These are enterprise deployment scenarios where SDK compatibility is critical. Workarounds exist (pin version, disable features) but degrade functionality.

source_issues.title: eager_input_streaming breaks Bedrock deployments: "Extra inputs are not permitted"

source_issues.title: [Bug] SDK maps thinking={"type":"disabled"} to --max-thinking-tokens 0, which breaks Anthropic-compatible providers
source_issues.evidence: User sets thinking={"type":"disabled"} but SDK downgrades to --max-thinking-tokens 0 which is not equivalent for third-party backends. ThinkingBlock still appears despite explicit disabled request.

signals.topic: Session file reliability issues (race conditions, unflushed data)
signals.summary: Session JSONL files intermittently lose data due to race conditions and improper flushing when subprocess terminates. This breaks session resume functionality.
signals.review_reason: Session persistence is fundamental to multi-turn conversations. Race conditions and unflushed data cause silent data loss, breaking session resume - a core SDK feature. Issue 625 was closed but 584 remains open, suggesting the problem persists.

source_issues.title: Session file not flushed before subprocess termination in ClaudeSDKClient
source_issues.evidence: ResultMessage received by SDK consumer but corresponding entry not written to session file. SubprocessCLITransport.close() sends EOF then immediately checks process status without waiting for flush.

source_issues.title: Race condition when writing *.jsonl session file
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'resuming by giving the session ID would fail' after client disconnects. Multi-turn conversation setup breaks due to timing issues with session file writes.

signals.topic: Message parsing failures on unknown CLI event types
signals.summary: SDK raises MessageParseError when CLI emits unrecognized message types like rate_limit_event. This blocks all queries and requires monkey-patching workaround.
signals.review_reason: Parser fragility causes hard failures on legitimate CLI events. Users on Max subscription cannot use SDK at all without monkey-patching. SDK should handle unknown types gracefully rather than crashing.

source_issues.title: MessageParseError on rate_limit_event from CLI (v0.0.25)
source_issues.evidence: MessageParseError: Unknown message type: rate_limit_event raised on every query when using Max subscription with OAuth. Parser has exhaustive match and raises on unrecognized type.

source_issues.title: Tool use denial in print mode results in `tool_use_result` event without an accompanying `tool_use` event
source_issues.evidence: Tool denied during session init causes tool_use_result event without matching tool_use event. When resuming session, this inconsistent state causes problems.

signals.topic: SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after tool calls

signals.review_reason: Critical blocker: SDK CLI completely hangs after tool calls, preventing any synthesis/response. User cannot complete workflows and must kill the process. Workaround requires bypassing SDK entirely and using Messages API with separate API key.

source_issues.title: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after successful tool calls
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible across 5+ runs over 3 days. Identical workload completes via Messages API in 79 minutes but SDK CLI hangs indefinitely. Zero tokens emitted after last tool call.

signals.topic: Session transcript corruption causes API 400 errors on resume/compact
signals.summary: SDK writes illegal entries to JSONL transcripts (empty text blocks, orphaned tool_results) that cause API validation errors when sessions are resumed or compacted, forcing users to implement custom transcript sanitization workarounds
signals.review_reason: Breaks core session resumption workflow for long-running agents. Users must implement fragile workarounds. High impact with cascading error loops.

source_issues.title: SDK writes illegal entries to session JSONL transcripts (empty text blocks + orphaned tool_results)
source_issues.evidence: 400 validation errors from Claude API, interrupts ongoing agent sessions, wastes API calls, requires custom transcript repair logic

signals.topic: Sandbox silently falls back to unsandboxed execution when dependencies missing
signals.summary: When sandbox.enabled=true but bwrap/socat are not installed, SDK silently degrades to completely unsandboxed execution with no error or warning, creating false sense of security
signals.review_reason: Critical security issue - users explicitly opt into sandboxing but get no enforcement and no warning. False sense of security with real security implications.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: Bash commands run with full filesystem and network access regardless of sandbox configuration, no programmatic detection available

signals.topic: Custom systemPrompt ignored by agent since v0.2.15+
signals.summary: Agent ignores custom role/behavior instructions defined in systemPrompt starting from v0.2.15, reverting to generic Claude assistant behavior and breaking custom workflow agents
signals.review_reason: Breaks core functionality for users building custom agents/workflows. Users are locked to old versions as workaround. Main workflow blocking issue.

source_issues.title: Custom `systemPrompt` string ignored by agent in v0.2.15+ — agent does not follow custom role/behavior instructions
source_issues.evidence: Agent reverts to 'I am Claude' identity regardless of custom prompt, breaks all custom workflow agents, users forced to stay on v0.2.14

signals.topic: Zod v4 field descriptions dropped from MCP tool schemas
signals.summary: When using Zod v4, field-level .describe() metadata is not preserved in MCP tools/list schemas, so models don't see field guidance like description: z.string().describe('use English')
signals.review_reason: Affects tool usability - models don't receive field-level guidance. Breaks Zod v4 compatibility which is declared as peerDependency.

source_issues.title: createSdkMcpServer drops Zod v4 field .describe() metadata from tool inputSchema
source_issues.evidence: Property descriptions stripped from inputSchema, z.toJSONSchema works correctly in Zod v4 but SDK conversion path doesn't

signals.topic: SDK returns vague/missing error information
signals.summary: SDK returns subtype: 'error_during_execution' but is_error: false and empty errors array, preventing users from showing meaningful error messages to end users
signals.review_reason: Significant UX degradation - users cannot surface meaningful errors to end users. Inconsistent error state (error_during_execution but is_error: false).

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK
source_issues.evidence: Contradictory error flags (error_during_execution + is_error: false), empty errors array when network fails, too vague for user-facing apps

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase fails or hangs on repos with non-main default branch or submodules
signals.summary: The restoreConfigFromBase feature introduced in v1.0.74+ causes complete workflow failure on repos where default branch is not 'main', and hangs indefinitely (hours) on repos containing .gitmodules/submodules. Root cause: hardcoded 'main' fallback and git operations blocking on submodule authentication prompts.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency issue (3 reports) causing complete workflow blocking - either immediate failure or multi-hour hangs requiring manual cancellation. Directly prevents users from running the action at all.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: Action fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' when default branch is master

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: For issue_comment on PR, falls back to hardcoded 'main' causing fetch failure

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with .gitmodules (submodules)
source_issues.evidence: Workflow hung for ~4 hours until manually cancelled when repo has .gitmodules

signals.topic: Bedrock authentication completely broken since v1.0.74+
signals.summary: Bedrock users encounter 'Could not load credentials from any providers' error despite valid OIDC credentials being set up and confirmed working. The action fails immediately with 0 tokens used, never making an API call. Regression introduced in v1.0.74/v1.0.75 releases.
signals.review_reason: Complete authentication failure for Bedrock/LiteLLM users blocks all workflows. Users cannot use the action with AWS Bedrock despite valid credentials. Clear regression introduced in recent versions.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials present, but Claude Code fails with 'Could not load credentials from any providers'

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: Same credentials work with @anthropic-ai/sdk directly but fail in action via agent SDK binary

signals.topic: Code review completes successfully but produces no PR comment
signals.summary: The code-review plugin or PR-triggered workflows run to completion (spending API credits, 7+ minutes), but the result is empty and no comment is posted to the PR. Root cause: session ends on TodoWrite tool call instead of text message, or only inline comments are posted with no general summary.
signals.review_reason: Wastes user resources (API credits, time) when reviews complete but output is lost. Users expect visible feedback on PRs but get nothing, causing confusion about whether the action worked.

source_issues.title: code-review plugin completes review but produces empty result — no PR comment posted
source_issues.evidence: Session completed 24 turns in ~7 min, review text generated, but 'result' was empty so no comment posted

source_issues.title: PR-triggered workflows produce no visible output when Claude has no inline diff comments
source_issues.evidence: Action logs show 'No buffered inline comments', workflow completes successfully with zero visible output

signals.topic: Installation failures - 403 from CDN or SDK execution errors
signals.summary: Action fails during Claude Code installation phase with either 403 Forbidden from the install.sh CDN (v2.1.79 binary unavailable) or cryptic SDK execution errors that prevent the action from running at all.
signals.review_reason: Blocks the action from even starting - users cannot use the product at all. CDN 403 was a release-level issue affecting all v1 users. SDK errors are cryptic and prevent debugging.

source_issues.title: v1 action fails to install Claude Code v2.1.79 (403 from install.sh)
source_issues.evidence: curl returns 403 when downloading v2.1.79 native binary. 'Claude Code installed successfully' printed despite failure.

source_issues.title: SDK execution error
source_issues.evidence: Cryptic SDK error with minified stack trace prevents action from running. Issue has 8 comments indicating multiple affected users.

signals.topic: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error
signals.summary: All workflows using claude_code_oauth_token fail immediately during token exchange with 500 Internal Server Error. The issue persisted for 7+ hours with no recovery, affecting all PR-triggered and issue comment workflows.
signals.review_reason: Service-side outage blocking all OAuth-based workflows. Though single report, the impact is complete workflow failure for extended duration (7+ hours), making the action unusable for anyone relying on OAuth authentication.

source_issues.title: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error since Mar 18 12:00 UTC
source_issues.evidence: All 3 retry attempts fail with 500 error. Multiple example failed runs provided.

signals.topic: Cowork context compaction happens silently without warning
signals.summary: In Cowork sessions, context compaction occurs without any visible indicator. Users lose critical context mid-task with no warning, causing Claude to forget SSH connections, database schemas, and current task state.
signals.review_reason: Silent context loss mid-task significantly impacts productivity. User loses accumulated context without warning, forcing time-consuming reconstruction. Multiple related issues confirm this is a widespread problem.

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Visible context window usage indicator in Cowork
source_issues.evidence: User with 50+ Cowork sessions reports context compaction silently reset session mid-task multiple times. Critical context disappears without summary. Cites related issues #24677, #13171, #34363 showing widespread impact.

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Visible context window usage indicator in Cowork
source_issues.evidence: Same user reports 45 minutes into complex session, compaction fired without warning - Claude forgot SSH connection, database relationships, pipeline code. Lost 15 minutes reconstructing context.

signals.topic: Desktop app becomes completely unresponsive with stuck visualization panel
signals.summary: Claude Code Desktop stops responding to any messages, showing blank interface with stuck 'Configuring visualization' panel. Multiple troubleshooting steps (cache clear, reinstall, model switch) don't resolve. CLI works fine.
signals.review_reason: Complete app failure blocking all usage. User cannot use Desktop app at all after multiple recovery attempts. High severity as it renders the primary interface unusable.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude Code Desktop unresponsive to messages with stuck visualization panel
source_issues.evidence: User reports complete app failure - no response to any messages, blank interface. CLI works but Desktop is unusable. Tried cache clear, reinstall, model switch - none resolved.

signals.topic: Credentials stored in wrong directory when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set
signals.summary: When CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR points to a custom path, Claude Code creates credentials in a literal '~' subdirectory of CWD instead of the intended config directory. Deleting this wrong directory forces re-login.
signals.review_reason: Authentication flow broken for users with custom config directories. Causes repeated login prompts and credential scattering across filesystem.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Credentials stored in literal ~ subdirectory of CWD when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set
source_issues.evidence: Credentials written to <CWD>/~/.claude-personal/.credentials.json instead of /home/user/.claude-personal/.credentials.json. Deleting the wrong directory causes re-login prompt, proving the bug.

signals.topic: Claude Code ignores user preferences for web search and produces hallucinations
signals.summary: Claude Code ignores preference settings that instruct it to look things up, produces confabulated information about features/capabilities that don't exist, and requires manual per-request approval for web searches even when preferences request automatic lookup.
signals.review_reason: Wrong outputs in code context matter more than chat. User preferences being ignored leads to hallucinations and wasted time in rabbit holes. Trust degradation from repeated false information.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude Code ignores user preferences for web search and produces hallucinations about tool capabilities
source_issues.evidence: User reports Claude Code makes up features that don't exist, ignores preferences asking for web lookup, requires manual approval for each web search. Severely impacted trust compared to Claude Desktop experience.

signals.topic: Hooks functionality broken and misleadingly documented
signals.summary: Stop hooks fail with JSON validation errors, prompt hooks on UserPromptSubmit can only block (not inject context), hooks don't fire in -p mode, and documentation doesn't distinguish capabilities per hook type per event.
signals.review_reason: Significant time waste (15+ hours) trying to implement documented features that don't work. Affects users trying to enforce behavioral constraints, though it's a more advanced use case.

source_issues.title: Hook documentation is misleading — Stop hooks broken, prompt hooks can't inject context, capabilities undocumented per event type
source_issues.evidence: 15+ hours across 3 sessions testing hooks. Stop hooks produce persistent JSON validation errors. Prompt hooks limited to yes/no gatekeeping contrary to docs. -p mode skips hooks entirely (undocumented).

signals.topic: Usage quota transparency & model quality degradation on Opus 4.6
signals.summary: 用户报告无法验证 '2x usage promo' 是否真实生效，缺乏配额计数器或API端点来追踪剩余用量。同时观察到 Opus 4.6 在复杂推理任务上质量显著下降：跳过计算逻辑、编造数值、用模式匹配替代实际计算。Reddit 多个帖子（r/ClaudeAI, r/ClaudeCode）也印证了此问题。
signals.review_reason: 这是真实用户痛点：付费用户无法验证促销承诺是否兑现（成本损失），且模型质量下降直接影响工作产出（主流程受阻）。虽为单 issue 但影响面广（Max 计划用户、API 用户），且有社区反馈佐证。

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确指出：(1) 无计数器/API验证配额 (2) Opus 4.6 质量下降 - 编造数值、跳过计算 (3) Reddit 多处反馈相同问题

signals.topic: Korean/multilingual token inefficiency (2-3x higher API cost)
signals.summary: 韩语文本在当前 tokenizer 下消耗 2-3 倍于英语的 token 数量，导致 API 用户成本更高、上下文窗口更快耗尽。问题源于 BPE/Unigram 将 11,172 个韩语音节块视为独立符号而非可分解的 68 个 jamo 组件。
signals.review_reason: 这是真实成本影响痛点：韩语用户为相同语义内容支付 2-3 倍费用。但本质是 tokenizer 架构改进请求，且为单一 RFC issue，无其他用户复现报告，故降为 P2。

source_issues.title: [RFC] Korean Tokenization: Jamo Decomposition as Pre-tokenizer
source_issues.evidence: RFC 文档详细说明了韩语 token 开销 2-3x 于英语，引用 KR-BERT 等研究证实问题

signals.topic: Tool context persistence vs skill discard inconsistency
signals.summary: 用户发现 custom tool search tool 在使用后保留在对话历史中（占用上下文空间），而 skills 在使用后被丢弃。这种不一致导致上下文窗口更快耗尽，且当用户改变问题参数时工具无法正确重新匹配。
signals.review_reason: 这是设计不一致导致的上下文效率问题，会影响长时间对话的用户体验。但 issue 已关闭（可能是设计如此），且为单一 question 类型 issue，故降为 P2。

source_issues.title: [QUESTION] : tool search tool ' : persistent context usage
source_issues.evidence: 用户实测发现工具保留在历史中占用上下文，且改变问题参数后工具无法正确匹配

signals.topic: Telegram plugin silently loses inbound messages
signals.summary: Messages sent by users are permanently lost without notification when MCP channel drops, session restarts, or multiple instances run. Users have no indication their messages were not processed.
signals.review_reason: Critical user pain point: users send messages believing they will be processed, but messages are silently dropped. This breaks the core communication flow and causes confusion as users don't know if Claude received their input. High frequency (3 issues) indicates this is a recurring problem across multiple failure modes.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: inbound messages silently lost when MCP channel drops or session restarts
source_issues.evidence: When the Claude --channels session restarts (crash, keepalive restart, idle timeout), any Telegram messages sent during the gap are permanently lost with no indication to the user.

source_issues.title: Telegram: zombie bun server.ts processes steal updates + unawaited mcp.notification()
source_issues.evidence: Zombie bun server.ts processes from previous sessions consume Telegram updates, causing inbound messages to be silently dropped.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin starts polling in non-channel instances, stealing updates
source_issues.evidence: When multiple Claude Code instances run in the same project, each spawns its own Telegram MCP plugin process. Non-channel instances steal updates meant for the channel instance.

signals.topic: Windows platform compatibility failures across plugins
signals.summary: Multiple plugins fail to work correctly on Windows due to path handling issues, executable permission checks, and multipart upload problems. Windows users experience broken functionality in Vercel, Telegram, and ralph-loop plugins.
signals.review_reason: High user impact: Windows users cannot use core functionality across multiple plugins. The Vercel check fails on every session start, file uploads fail in Telegram, and ralph-loop breaks for users with spaces in paths. This blocks Windows users from productive use of the plugins.

source_issues.title: [vercel] Vercel CLI falsely reported as 'not installed' on Windows — accessSync(X_OK) fails
source_issues.evidence: The Vercel plugin's session-start-profiler.mjs hook falsely reports 'The Vercel CLI is not installed' on every session start on Windows, even though vercel is installed and working.

source_issues.title: ralph-loop: Stop hook breaks on paths with spaces (Windows)
source_issues.evidence: The ralph-loop stop hook fails on Windows when the user profile path contains spaces or special characters.

source_issues.title: fix(telegram): sendDocument/sendPhoto fails on Windows+Bun (multipart upload broken)
source_issues.evidence: Reply with files parameter fails on Windows with Bun runtime. Text messages work fine, but any file attachment throws a network request error.

signals.topic: Telegram MCP server crashes and confusing error handling
signals.summary: The Telegram MCP server crashes after processing messages and returns confusing error messages. Users see network errors even when operations succeed, undermining trust in the plugin.
signals.review_reason: Significant user impact: server crashes after every message make the plugin unreliable for continuous use. Confusing error messages (showing failure when operation succeeded) undermine user trust and cause users to retry unnecessarily or abandon the plugin.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: MCP server crashes after every inbound message (unhandled promise rejections)
source_issues.evidence: The MCP server exits immediately after forwarding the first message to Claude. The session appears to work once, then dies and must be restarted.

source_issues.title: sendPhoto API returns "Network request failed" error but photo is actually sent successfully
source_issues.evidence: When using the Telegram plugin's reply tool with an image file, the API call fails with error 'Network request for sendPhoto failed!' but the photo is actually sent and received successfully.

signals.topic: Discord plugin process leaks and stale configuration
signals.summary: Discord MCP server processes become orphaned when sessions end, accumulating over time and consuming CPU. Additionally, access.json configuration is cached and not reloaded when changed, requiring manual intervention.
signals.review_reason: User pain point: orphan processes degrade system performance over time (CPU saturation) without the user understanding the cause. Stale configuration prevents users from making access control changes take effect, potentially leaving channels inaccessible or overly permissive.

source_issues.title: Discord plugin: MCP server leaks orphan processes when Claude Code session ends
source_issues.evidence: The Discord plugin's MCP server becomes an orphan process when the parent Claude Code session ends. Over time, hundreds of these processes accumulate and saturate the CPU.

source_issues.title: Discord plugin: access.json cache goes stale, requires manual reload
source_issues.evidence: The Discord MCP plugin caches access.json in memory and does not re-read it when the file changes on disk. Configuration changes don't take effect until manual reload.

signals.topic: ralph-loop stop hook error handling issues
signals.summary: The ralph-loop stop hook produces errors when no loop is active (empty stdout interpreted as failure) and fails on Windows with special characters in paths.
signals.review_reason: User annoyance: errors appear after every turn when ralph-loop is not in use or when paths contain spaces. Non-blocking but creates noise in the user experience and confusion about what is failing.

source_issues.title: ralph-loop: Stop hook outputs empty stdout when no active loop, causing 'non-blocking status code' error
source_issues.evidence: When no ralph-loop is active, the stop hook exits with code 0 but produces empty stdout. Claude Code interprets this as a hook error and shows a non-blocking status code error after every turn.

source_issues.title: ralph-loop: Stop hook breaks on paths with spaces (Windows)
source_issues.evidence: The ralph-loop stop hook fails on Windows when the user profile path contains spaces or special characters. Error message shown after every turn.

signals.topic: 日语输入字符丢失导致搜索功能异常
signals.summary: 在 computer-use-demo 中使用日语输入时，由于 TYPING_DELAY_MS 参数值过低，日语字符的转换过程无法及时完成，导致输入字符丢失，影响非英语用户的正常使用
signals.review_reason: 这是一个真实用户痛点：非英语用户在使用 computer-use-demo 时会遇到字符输入丢失问题，直接影响搜索等核心功能。但仅有1个 issue 报告，且用户建议通过文档说明解决，影响范围有限，因此标记为 P2。

source_issues.title: Documentation Update Proposal for computer-use-demo in Japanese Input
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告在 Firefox 搜索栏输入日语时字符丢失，例如输入'東京都'时丢失'都'字，原因是 TYPING_DELAY_MS 值过低导致日语转换过程未完成

signals.topic: Poor discoverability of document skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx)
signals.summary: High-value document skills are nearly invisible to users due to hidden marketplace, bundle naming, lack of search functionality, and no auto-suggestion mechanism
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降：用户无法发现和使用高价值技能，甚至 Claude 自身都无法定位这些技能。问题涉及多个方面：市场默认不可见、捆绑包命名不直观、无搜索功能、无自动建议。但属于可发现性问题而非主流程阻断

source_issues.title: Document-skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) are nearly invisible to users — discoverability and naming problem
source_issues.evidence: User spent two full sessions doing heavy PDF work using raw Python before discovering the PDF skill existed. Claude itself incorrectly stated 'No PDF skill exists'. Required 3 rounds of web searching to find it on GitHub

source_issues.title: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
source_issues.evidence: User-installed skills have no mechanism to override or modify system skill behavior. When a user skill rule conflicts with a system skill, the system skill always wins, making customization ineffective

signals.topic: Windows platform crash due to missing UTF-8 encoding in docx skill
signals.summary: The docx skill's validate.py and pack.py scripts crash on Windows with UnicodeEncodeError/UnicodeDecodeError because they use system default encoding (cp1252) instead of UTF-8 for file I/O and print output
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：docx skill 在 Windows 平台上完全无法正常工作，validate.py 和 pack.py 均崩溃。用户需要手动设置环境变量作为临时解决方案，这直接影响用户完成文档处理任务的能力

source_issues.title: [Bug] docx skill: validate.py and pack.py crash on Windows due to missing UTF-8 encoding in file I/O and print output
source_issues.evidence: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u2192' in print statements; UnicodeDecodeError when reading XML files without UTF-8 encoding. Users must set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 as workaround

signals.topic: Config file corruption from race condition in skill-creator
signals.summary: The .claude.json configuration file gets corrupted during high-frequency file system activity when using the skill-creator plugin, causing users to lose authentication state and need to re-configure
signals.review_reason: 数据丢失与体验严重下降：用户反复丢失配置、需要重新认证和重新进行新用户流程。问题已复现多次，有明确的备份文件和调试日志证据

source_issues.title: Skill Creator causes config file corruption
source_issues.evidence: Corruption pattern shows non-atomic write path racing with atomic (temp+rename) writer. Two corruption events documented with backup files showing leftover bytes from previous file content. Config reset causes loss of projects, toolUsage, tipsHistory, clientDataCache

signals.topic: Skill installation failure for marketplace skills
signals.summary: Users cannot install certain skills like internal-comms even after adding the marketplace, receiving 'skill not found' errors
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：用户按照正常流程添加市场后仍无法安装所需技能，导致功能完全无法使用

source_issues.title: [BUG] Unable to install internal-comms skill
source_issues.evidence: User added anthropics/skills marketplace but searching for internal-comms returns no results. Manual install via /plugin install internal-comms@anthropic-agent-skills also fails with 'skill not found'

signals.topic: Provider tool calling failures across multiple providers
signals.summary: Multiple LLM providers (NanoGPT, Bedrock) fail to properly invoke tools/extensions, blocking core Goose functionality. Users report models work with other software but fail specifically with Goose's tool calling implementation.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality (tool calling) is broken for multiple providers. Users cannot complete basic workflows like creating apps. Clear user impact with failed operations and blocked sessions.

source_issues.title: NanoGPT provider appears unable to call tools/extensions
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'Error: LLM did not call the required tool: create_app_content' when using NanoGPT. Same models work with OpenRouter. Tested multiple models (Kimi 2.5, Deepseek 0324, Minimax M2.7) - all failed with Goose but succeed with other software via NanoGPT API.

source_issues.title: Bedrock provider sends null toolUse.input for no-argument tool calls
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock's Converse API rejects tool calls with ValidationException: 'The value at messages.1.content.0.toolUse.input is empty.' Root cause identified in serialization code mapping null arguments incorrectly.

signals.topic: STDIO extensions fail to initialize on macOS
signals.summary: STDIO-type MCP extensions using npx fail on macOS due to PATH resolution issues in Hermit bootstrap. GUI-launched Goose cannot find system utilities (chown) or Node.js binaries, preventing extension loading.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users from using MCP extensions on macOS. Requires manual workaround involving PATH edits and symlink creation. High friction prevents normal extension usage.

source_issues.title: [macOS] STDIO extensions fail: 'chown: command not found' and 'env: node: No such file or directory' in Hermit bootstrap
source_issues.evidence: User provides detailed error logs showing 'chown: command not found' (exit 127) and 'env: node: No such file or directory'. Extension panel shows 6/7 loaded with 'Goose Docs' failed. Required manual PATH fixes and symlink creation to work around.

signals.topic: CLI paste auto-executes and creates infinite loop
signals.summary: Pasting text into the Windows CLI causes Goose to auto-execute the pasted content as a prompt, and when the text requires abbreviation, this triggers an infinite inescapable loop until Goose is terminated.
signals.review_reason: Disrupts user workflow significantly - cannot paste content without triggering unwanted execution. Infinite loop requires force-terminating Goose, causing potential data loss.

source_issues.title: Pasting into CLI auto executes and creates an infinite prompt loop
source_issues.evidence: User provides screenshots showing auto-repeat prompt behavior. Pasting text that requires Goose abbreviation causes continuous auto-execution until shutdown. Windows CLI on Win 11.

signals.topic: Windows KeyRing secret storage breaks MCP OAuth
signals.summary: Windows KeyRing cannot store secrets larger than 2560 bytes (1280 chars as Unicode). When users store multiple API keys or MCP OAuth tokens, they hit this limit and receive cryptic 'auth_error' messages without explanation.
signals.review_reason: Blocks MCP OAuth flow on Windows for users with multiple stored credentials. Error message provides no actionable guidance. Core authentication functionality broken.

source_issues.title: Windows KeyRing makes Goose unusable with MCP OAuth
source_issues.evidence: User reports KeyRing limitation causes 'auth_error' without detailed logging when storing OAuth AccessToken+RefreshToken. Suggests file-based secrets.yaml as alternative without size limits.

signals.topic: Goose CLI self-update fails on Linux
signals.summary: Running 'goose update' on Linux fails with 'Text file busy (os error 26)' when attempting to replace the running binary. Users cannot update to new versions through the built-in mechanism.
signals.review_reason: Users cannot update Goose through official mechanism. Forces manual intervention to get security updates and new features. Affects standard Linux configurations.

source_issues.title: Goose cli fails to update on linux
source_issues.evidence: User shows error: 'Failed to copy new binary...Text file busy (os error 26)'. Standard ext4 filesystem. Download succeeds but binary replacement fails.

signals.topic: stagehand.extract() 运行时失败 - Zod v4 toJSONSchema 方法未找到
signals.summary: 用户在使用 Zod v4 风格的 schema 对象调用 stagehand.extract() 时，因 Stagehand 内部 zod 导入与 schema 版本不匹配，抛出 'Zod v4 toJSONSchema method not found' 运行时错误，导致数据提取功能完全不可用
signals.review_reason: 明确的用户影响证据：用户在生产部署中调用核心 API stagehand.extract() 时遭遇运行时错误，导致数据提取主流程完全失败。问题发生在官方支持的依赖版本范围内，属于版本兼容性缺陷

signals.review_reason: Clear performance regression with detailed benchmark evidence. Users experience significant slowdown when using HuggingFaceEmbeddings on GPU/MPS devices, impacting production workloads processing large document corpora.

source_issues.title: perf: HuggingFaceEmbeddings causes excessive device-to-cpu transfers per batch
source_issues.evidence: Profiling shows 32 synchronizations instead of 1 for 1,000 texts at batch_size=32, adding ~640ms overhead on M4 MacBook Air. Benchmark shows 1.157s baseline vs 0.631s fixed (1.84x faster)

signals.topic: Package version compatibility breaks dependency resolution
signals.summary: langchain-together package has dependency conflicts with v1 versions of langchain-openai and related packages, causing 'No solution found' errors during dependency resolution.
signals.review_reason: Users cannot install or update their projects due to version incompatibility between langchain ecosystem packages. This blocks new project setup and dependency updates, though it may be environment-specific.

source_issues.title: langchain-together breaks with v1 versions of langchain-openai and so on
source_issues.evidence: uv sync fails with 'No solution found when resolving dependencies' - langchain-together<=0.3.1 available but project requires langchain-together>=1.0, blocking project setup

signals.topic: LangChain platform contact sales page routing error
signals.summary: The 'Contact Sales' button on the LangChain platform pricing page redirects users to an error page instead of the intended destination.
signals.review_reason: UI bug that blocks enterprise users from contacting sales. While not a SDK issue, it represents a business-critical user journey interruption on the LangChain platform.

source_issues.title: contact sales on the langchain platform shows error routing request
source_issues.evidence: User reports that clicking 'contact sales' on production pricing page directs to an error page - prevents enterprise sales inquiries

signals.topic: Background runs re-executed after ~180s causing duplicate work and API cost waste
signals.summary: Users on LangGraph Cloud experience background runs being re-executed after exactly ~181 seconds despite BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS being set higher, resulting in duplicate work and wasted API costs for long-running nodes (3-7 minutes).
signals.review_reason: Direct cost impact: users incur duplicate API costs when background runs are re-executed. Long-running operations (3-7 min) are common in production agent workflows.

source_issues.title: Background runs re-executed after ~180s despite BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS being set higher
source_issues.evidence: User reports duplicate API costs: 'This results in duplicate work and wasted API costs' with nodes taking 3-7 minutes being re-run at exactly ~181s

signals.topic: Random CancelledError in AsyncPregelLoop cleanup causing sporadic production failures
signals.summary: Users experience random asyncio.CancelledError during AsyncPregelLoop cleanup phase when running agents on LangSmith Cloud, causing unpredictable failures in production environments.
signals.review_reason: Production reliability impact: sporadic failures in async cleanup cause unpredictable crashes in production agent deployments.

source_issues.title: Random CancelledError in AsyncPregelLoop cleanup
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'random asyncio.CancelledError during AsyncPregelLoop cleanup phase when running agents on LangSmith Cloud' with full stack trace provided

signals.topic: Run cancellation loses streamed state not persisted as checkpoint
signals.summary: When canceling a LangGraph run during streaming, all streamed data since the last checkpoint is lost. Users see output rendered but it disappears after cancellation, creating inconsistent UX.
signals.review_reason: Data loss/UX impact: users lose visible streamed content they already read. Creates 'what you saw is not what is saved' inconsistency in chat applications.

source_issues.title: Run Cancellation Causes Loss of Streamed State Not Yet Persisted as a Checkpoint
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states: 'Users can see output for several seconds (or longer), but after canceling and sending a new message, that output disappears'

signals.topic: ToolNode lacks model output metadata in error messages preventing self-correction
signals.summary: When tool calls fail due to output truncation or other model-side issues, ToolNode only returns exception text without response metadata (stop_reason, finish_reason). Models cannot diagnose root causes and may retry indefinitely.
signals.review_reason: Token/cost waste + workflow blocking: models waste tokens on infinite retries without root cause context. 249 retries represents significant cost and time waste.

source_issues.title: ToolNode: surface model output metadata in tool error messages to enable self-correction
source_issues.evidence: User reports model 'retried 249 times, never learning why its arguments were malformed' due to missing truncation context in error messages

signals.topic: StructuredTool.invoke() requires ToolRuntime blocking standalone unit testing
signals.summary: Users cannot invoke StructuredTool instances standalone for unit testing because ToolRuntime is required but unavailable outside graph execution context.
signals.review_reason: Developer workflow impact: blocks standard unit testing patterns for tools. Forces workarounds or integration tests instead of unit tests.

source_issues.title: Calling .invoke() as standalone on a StructuredTool requires a ToolRuntime object
source_issues.evidence: User asks 'what is the proper way to call invoke on a previously created tool function when there is no ToolRuntime since the tool function is being called standalone as part of a unit test'

signals.topic: Plugin Daemon Service 500 Error on Dify Cloud
signals.summary: Users experience sudden 'Request to Plugin Daemon Service failed-500' errors when running workflows on Dify Cloud, blocking workflow execution without any changes made to the system
signals.review_reason: Critical user pain point: workflow execution is completely blocked on Dify Cloud with 500 error from Plugin Daemon Service, directly impacting production workflows. Cloud service issue affects users unexpectedly without any configuration changes.

source_issues.title: Sudden error without changes "Request to Plugin Daemon Service failed-500" (DIFY CLOUD 1.13.2)
source_issues.evidence: User running AWS Bedrock Claude Sonnet 3.7 workflow received 500 error after 10 minutes. Was working before without any changes. Screenshot shows 'Request to Plugin Daemon Service failed-500' blocking workflow execution.

signals.topic: Plugin Installation and Update Failure on v1.13.2
signals.summary: Users cannot install new plugins or update existing plugins on Dify version 1.13.x, blocking ability to extend platform functionality
signals.review_reason: Key user pain point: plugin marketplace functionality is completely broken in v1.13.2, preventing users from installing or updating plugins - a core extensibility feature of the platform.

source_issues.title: Plugins install and update error on version 1.13.2
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'Cannot install new plugins and update new version on 1.13.x' with screenshot showing error. Plugin marketplace is a core feature for extending Dify capabilities.

signals.topic: Local Model Infinite Generation Loop Cannot Be Stopped
signals.summary: When using local models with Dify, if a model enters an infinite generation loop, clicking 'Stop generating' on frontend does not stop the backend inference process, causing GPU memory to remain at 98-99% usage
signals.review_reason: Critical infrastructure pain point: Frontend stop button is ineffective for local model inference, causing GPU resource exhaustion (98-99% memory) and potential system instability. Users cannot interrupt runaway generation loops.

source_issues.title: Frontend interrupt cannot stop local model infinite generation loop, model keeps outputting and occupying GPU memory
source_issues.evidence: User shows detailed logs with model continuing to generate tokens at 45 tokens/s after frontend stop clicked. GPU memory stuck at 98-99% on multiple NVIDIA RTX 6000D GPUs. This causes significant resource waste and potential system instability.

signals.topic: File Upload Failure After Version Upgrade (1.12.0 to 1.13.2)
signals.summary: After upgrading from v1.12.0 to v1.13.2, file uploads fail with ImportError due to module naming conflict between 'events' package and Dify's internal events module
signals.review_reason: Critical regression: Version upgrade completely breaks file upload functionality due to module naming conflict. This is a blocking issue that prevents users from using knowledge base features after upgrading. Strong evidence with full error traceback.

source_issues.title: Files Fail to Be Uploaded After the Version Is Upgraded from 1.12.0 to 1.13.2
source_issues.evidence: Full traceback shows ImportError: cannot import name 'Events' from 'events' (/app/api/events/__init__.py) - Python module naming conflict between opensearchpy dependency and Dify's internal events module blocks all file uploads after upgrade.

signals.topic: GitHub OAuth Login Fails with Private Email
signals.summary: Users with GitHub private email settings cannot log in to Dify Cloud, receiving validation error 'email should be a valid string'
signals.review_reason: Login blocking issue: Users with GitHub private email cannot access Dify Cloud at all. This is a complete authentication failure preventing new user onboarding for a common GitHub privacy setting.

source_issues.title: Can not log in with GitHub
source_issues.evidence: User with GitHub private email receives '1 validation error for GitHubRawUserInfo\nemail\n Input should be a valid string [type=string_type, input_value=None, input_type=NoneType]' - OAuth flow fails because email is None.

signals.topic: 数据持久化失败 - 重启或更新时存储层数据丢失/损坏
signals.summary: 用户在使用Qdrant本地存储或Valkey时，程序重启或更新操作会导致数据被静默删除或嵌入向量损坏
signals.review_reason: 数据丢失是严重的主流程阻断问题，用户存储的记忆在重启后被静默删除，直接导致核心功能不可用，影响严重

source_issues.title: Bug Report: Qdrant Local Storage Loses Data on Restart Due to `on_disk` Default
source_issues.evidence: When using Qdrant with local `path` storage, all data is silently deleted on every program restart if `on_disk` is not explicitly set to True. shutil.rmtree(path) deletes all persisted data.

source_issues.title: Mem0 with Valkey: update() corrupts embeddings when called with vector=None
source_issues.evidence: The update() method unconditionally serializes the vector. When vector is None, np.array(None) produces a single-element array, corrupting all embeddings in the store.

signals.topic: 搜索功能异常 - 过滤条件导致搜索结果错误或完全失败
signals.summary: threshold参数在基于距离的向量存储中产生反转结果，search_memory函数在特定条件下抛出TypeError
signals.review_reason: 搜索是核心功能，结果错误或完全失败直接影响用户使用体验，属于明显功能缺陷

source_issues.title: fix: threshold filtering broken for distance-based vector stores
source_issues.evidence: The threshold check assumes scores are similarity (higher = better), but many vector stores return raw distance (lower = better). This causes threshold filtering to be inverted — good matches get dropped and bad matches pass through.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Operator precedence error in mcp_server.py search_memory function causes TypeError when filtering memories
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: argument of type 'NoneType' is not iterable when accessible_memory_ids is empty or None. This bug affects the MCP server's memory search functionality.

signals.topic: 多LLM兼容性问题 - Azure/Google Gemini后端功能完全失效
signals.summary: GoogleLLM忽略tools参数导致graph memory无实体产生，AzureOpenAIStructuredLLM缺少_parse_response方法导致每次调用都报错
signals.review_reason: 使用特定LLM提供商的用户遇到功能完全不可用的问题，Graph Memory等核心功能静默失败，属于阻断性问题

source_issues.title: GoogleLLM.generateResponse ignores tools parameter — graph memory silently produces no entities with Google/Gemini provider
source_issues.evidence: GoogleLLM.generateResponse does not pass the tools parameter to Gemini's generateContent API. Graph memory operations always return plain text — zero entities are extracted and Neo4j is never populated.

source_issues.title: AzureOpenAIStructuredLLM missing _parse_response method
source_issues.evidence: AzureOpenAIStructuredLLM calls self._parse_response(response, tools) but the method is never defined. This causes AttributeError every time generate_response() is called.

signals.topic: 配置不生效 - Docker环境变量和API配置无法正确保存或读取
signals.summary: Docker Compose中的环境变量被忽略，PUT /api/v1/config端点不调用保存函数导致配置无法持久化
signals.review_reason: 配置无法生效会影响用户部署体验，但通常有workaround，优先级相对较低

source_issues.title: Docker Compose env vars (LLM_PROVIDER, OLLAMA_BASE_URL, etc.) are ignored
source_issues.evidence: The config is stored in a SQLite DB, not read from environment variables. The .env file only matters for the initial OPENAI_API_KEY startup check.

source_issues.title: The PUT /api/v1/config endpoint is incomplete
source_issues.evidence: it accepts a request but never calls save_config_to_db() and doesn't return the saved config.

signals.topic: 同步阻塞 - MCP工具调用阻塞超过2分钟导致客户端无响应
signals.summary: add_memories MCP工具在处理时同步执行所有操作（嵌入生成、向量写入、图更新），阻塞客户端超过2分钟
signals.review_reason: 2分钟以上的阻塞严重影响用户体验，MCP客户端完全无法操作，属于明显的主流程影响问题

source_issues.title: OpenMemory MCP `add_memories` tool blocks synchronously for 2+ minutes
source_issues.evidence: A single add_memories call took 2 minutes 19 seconds to return. During this time, the MCP client is completely blocked and cannot proceed.

signals.topic: MCP Tool Integration Failures - Results Not Delivered in Streaming Mode
signals.summary: Users integrating MCP tools (MATLAB, hosted servers) cannot get tool results. MCPStdioTool drops successful results and returns errors. Streaming path never delivers mcp_server_tool_result content. AgentContext cannot be passed to MCPStreamableHTTPTool for authentication headers.
signals.review_reason: Critical pain point blocking main workflows. Users integrating MCP tools cannot get tool results in streaming mode or pass required authentication context. Causes complete workflow failures for external MCP tool integration.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: MCPStdioTool drops successful MATLAB MCP results and sends "Error: Function failed." instead
source_issues.evidence: Direct MCP SDK call succeeds, but MCPStdioTool.call_tool times out and returns Error instead of actual tool results. Blocks MATLAB MCP integration.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: Streaming path never delivers mcp_server_tool_result content — parity gap with non-streaming
source_issues.evidence: In streaming mode, mcp_server_tool_result events always have output=None. Response.mcp_call.completed event is dropped. UI cannot display MCP tool outputs.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: Unable to pass AgentContext to MCPStreamableHTTPTool
source_issues.evidence: No way to pass AgentContext values (auth headers) from middleware to MCP server calls. Required headers cannot be dynamically forwarded.

signals.topic: AG-UI Protocol Human-in-the-Loop Event Translation Failures
signals.summary: GitHubCopilotAgent does not translate Copilot SDK permission.requested events to AG-UI human-in-the-loop protocol events. Tool events not forwarded as FunctionCallContent/FunctionResultContent. Users cannot approve/deny tool calls in AG-UI clients like CopilotKit.
signals.review_reason: Blocks key AG-UI integration features. Users building with CopilotKit cannot implement human-in-the-loop approval workflows or see tool execution events. Only workaround is PermissionHandler.ApproveAll with no user oversight.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: GitHubCopilotAgent should translate Copilot SDK permission.requested events to AG-UI human-in-the-loop events
source_issues.evidence: Copilot SDK emits permission.requested events but AG-UI adapter does not emit corresponding human-in-the-loop events. Users cannot approve/deny tool calls.

source_issues.title: .NET [Feature]: GitHubCopilotAgent should translate Copilot SDK permission.requested events to AG-UI human-in-the-loop events
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause as #4826 - permission events not translated to AG-UI protocol.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: Tool events from GitHub Copilot SDK not forwarded as FunctionCallContent/FunctionResultContent
source_issues.evidence: Tool events not forwarded, preventing AG-UI clients from rendering tool calls properly.

signals.topic: Workflow Session State Serialization Failures with Handoff Orchestration
signals.summary: Using Workflow with Handoff orchestration fails on second request with InvalidDataException about checkpoint incompatibility. CompactionProvider causes duplicate user messages corrupting chat history. First request works, subsequent requests fail.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blockers. Workflow with Handoff is a core feature but fails on session resumption. Context management with CompactionProvider corrupts chat history, degrading agent behavior.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: InvalidDataException when using Workflow as Agent with Handoff orchestration
source_issues.evidence: Workflow with Handoff fails on second request with checkpoint incompatibility error. First request works, subsequent fail.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: Duplicate user messages when using CompactionProvider via ChatClientBuilder.UseAIContextProviders with ChatHistoryProvider
source_issues.evidence: CompactionProvider at builder level causes duplicate user messages in chat history, corrupting context management.

signals.topic: OpenAI Backend Unicode Escape Corruption in Function Calls
signals.summary: OpenAI path does double JSON parsing which corrupts unicode escape sequences like \u2192. Agents editing source code enter retry loops (10+ failed attempts) wasting tokens and writing corrupted code. Same code works correctly on Anthropic backend.
signals.review_reason: Causes significant experience degradation and cost losses. Agents waste tokens in retry loops when editing source code. Cross-provider inconsistency - works on Anthropic but fails on OpenAI.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: Normalize OpenAI function-call arguments at parse time to prevent unicode escape corruption
source_issues.evidence: Double JSON parsing corrupts unicode escapes. Agents waste tokens in 10+ retry loops when editing code with unicode. Cross-provider inconsistency.

signals.topic: Middleware Context Propagation Errors - Pydantic Schema and AgentContext
signals.summary: FunctionInvocationContext in @tool decorator causes PydanticSchemaGenerationError. Documentation shows patterns that fail at runtime. AgentContext values set in middleware cannot be passed to tool calls. Dynamic per-request headers (auth tokens) cannot be forwarded.
signals.review_reason: Middleware is essential for passing runtime context (auth tokens, user info) to tools. Documentation shows patterns that don't work. Blocks proper authentication/context flows in production agents.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: PydanticSchemaGenerationError in FunctionInvocationContext
source_issues.evidence: Using FunctionInvocationContext in @tool decorator causes Pydantic schema error. Documentation shows this pattern but fails at runtime. ctx.kwargs needed for middleware values.

signals.topic: AutoGen Studio JSON配置中extra_body参数被静默忽略导致工作流失败
signals.summary: 用户在AutoGen Studio中通过JSON配置OpenAIChatCompletionClient时，extra_body字段（如enable_thinking: false）在反序列化过程中被静默丢弃，导致对Qwen3等需要特殊参数的模型无法正常工作，API请求返回400错误
signals.review_reason: 用户在使用OpenAI兼容端点时主流程被阻断，有明确的错误日志和复现步骤，直接影响使用Qwen3等需要特殊参数模型的用户

source_issues.title: extra_body in OpenAIChatCompletionClient config is silently ignored when loaded via AutoGen Studio JSON
source_issues.evidence: 用户配置extra_body参数后API返回400错误: 'Assistant response prefill is incompatible with enable_thinking'，证明参数未被传递

signals.topic: 推理模型(gpt-5/o1)返回的列表内容未被正确处理导致空响应
signals.summary: OpenAIClient.message_retrieval未处理推理模型返回的列表格式内容(含reasoning和text块)，导致下游代码获取空或畸形响应
signals.review_reason: 推理模型是关键功能，用户无法正常使用gpt-5/o1等推理模型会直接影响核心工作流

source_issues.title: PyAutoGen Reasoning Content
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确指出使用gpt-5部署时message.content返回列表格式，但extract_text_or_completion_object处理失败导致空响应

signals.topic: JupyterCodeExecutor停止时泄漏临时目录和输出文件
signals.summary: JupyterCodeExecutor在stop()时未清理临时输出目录，与其他执行器行为不一致，长期运行会导致磁盘空间累积泄漏
signals.review_reason: 资源泄漏是持续运行环境中的实际问题，会影响长期部署的用户，有明确的复现代码和对比分析

source_issues.title: JupyterCodeExecutor leaks temporary output directory on stop — inconsistent with other executors
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了PoC证明3次执行后所有临时目录仍然存在，且与代码中其他executor的cleanup实现对比确认是bug

signals.topic: CodeExecutorAgent多态被破坏，子类覆盖方法不被调用
signals.summary: on_messages_stream中通过类名直接调用classmethod _reflect_on_code_block_results_flow，导致子类覆盖的方法被绕过
signals.review_reason: 破坏了框架的扩展性，用户无法通过继承自定义行为，影响了高级用户的正常使用场景

source_issues.title: Polymorphism issue: CodeExecutorAgent calls classmethod via concrete class in on_messages_stream
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确指出继承CodeExecutorAgent并覆盖方法后，父类方法仍被调用，并关联到类似的历史issue #5953

signals.topic: schema_to_pydantic_model转换时丢失$defs中的类型信息
signals.summary: 将JSON schema转换为Pydantic模型时，$defs中的类型定义(如array→object)信息丢失，导致生成的模型与原始schema不一致
signals.review_reason: 影响使用工具调用和结构化输出的用户，类型错误可能导致数据验证失败或运行时异常

source_issues.title: schema_to_pydantic_model loses $defs type information (array → object)
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了完整的复现代码，展示原始schema中TaskData为array类型，转换后变为object类型

signals.topic: response.body() returns double-encoded UTF-8 for SSE streaming responses
signals.summary: When using response.body() for Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming responses, Playwright returns mojibake due to double-encoded UTF-8 instead of the raw bytes sent by the server
signals.review_reason: Direct user impact on data integrity when working with SSE streaming responses. Causes incorrect data processing in applications that rely on SSE, a real workflow failure scenario.

source_issues.title: response.body() returns mojibake (double-encoded UTF-8) for SSE streaming responses
source_issues.evidence: User reports that response.body() returns double-encoded UTF-8 bytes for SSE streaming, causing data corruption. Affects both Python and JavaScript bindings. Expected raw UTF-8 bytes but receives incorrectly encoded data.

signals.topic: headless_shell ignores --remote-debugging-address, breaks Docker CDP access
signals.summary: When using headless mode with chromium headless_shell, the --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0 flag is silently ignored, always binding CDP to 127.0.0.1, preventing external DevTools connections from host machines in containerized environments
signals.review_reason: Breaks a core debugging workflow in containerized environments, which is a very common deployment pattern. The flag is silently ignored, making this a confusing and blocking issue for users running Playwright in Docker.

source_issues.title: headless_shell ignores --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0, always binds CDP to 127.0.0.1
source_issues.evidence: User cannot connect Chrome DevTools from host to Playwright running in Docker because headless_shell ignores the remote-debugging-address flag. Workarounds required (use full chromium binary or TCP proxy). Blocks remote debugging workflow.

signals.topic: HTML reporter fails to open in JetBrains IDEs (WebStorm/IntelliJ) since v1.57
signals.summary: Regression from v1.57 causes HTML reporter not to open when tests are run through JetBrains IDE test runner due to TTY detection changes. Previously worked in v1.56.1
signals.review_reason: Clear regression with significant user impact on developers using JetBrains IDEs. HTML reporter is a core feature and its failure to open disrupts the debugging and test review workflow.

source_issues.title: [Regression]: HTML reporter does not open anymore after executing test through WebStorm/Intellij test runner
source_issues.evidence: User reports regression where HTML reporter no longer opens when running tests via JetBrains IDEs. Version 1.56.1 worked correctly, 1.57+ broken. Affects developer workflow significantly as many developers use JetBrains IDEs.

signals.topic: Playwright randomly fails to exit, causing CI timeouts
signals.summary: Chrome-headless-shell occasionally doesn't exit after Playwright sends Browser.close via CDP, causing test workers to hang indefinitely and CI steps to timeout. Reported to occur 30-100 times per day in large-scale CI environments
signals.review_reason: High-frequency flaky failure causing CI pipeline hangs. User reports 30-100 occurrences daily. Directly impacts CI reliability and developer productivity. User had to implement workaround patch. 11 comments suggest this affects multiple users.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Playwright randomly not exitting
source_issues.evidence: User reports this happens 30-100 times per day across thousands of CI runs with 10 parallel workers. Tests complete but process hangs forever. User had to develop custom patch to add SIGKILL timeout. 11 comments indicate significant interest.

signals.topic: VSCode extension shows no tests when package.json has type: module
signals.summary: Playwright VSCode extension fails to discover tests when package.json contains "type": "module". Removing the field allows tests to be discovered, but this breaks ESM module support
signals.review_reason: Blocks developers using ESM modules from using VSCode test explorer integration. Forces users to choose between modern JavaScript module support and IDE test runner functionality - a fundamental workflow blocker.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: vscode extension shows no tests when type: module added to package.json
source_issues.evidence: User provides reproduction repo. Tests are not discovered in VSCode Test Explorer when "type": "module" is in package.json. Removing the field fixes test discovery but breaks ESM. Forces choice between ESM support and VSCode test integration.

signals.topic: Npgsql version incompatibility causing runtime crashes with PgVector connector
signals.summary: Users upgrading Npgsql to version 10.0.2 alongside Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.PgVector encounter MissingMethodException at runtime when calling CollectionExistsAsync(). The connector auto-installs Npgsql 8.0.7 which works, but upgrading breaks functionality.
signals.review_reason: Runtime crash blocks users from combining PgVector connector with Entity Framework when using newer Npgsql versions. Clear reproduction steps provided and affects real-world deployment scenarios.

source_issues.title: Bug: System.MissingMethodException: 'Method not found: 'System.Threading.Tasks.Task Npgsql.NpgsqlConnection.ReloadTypesAsync()'.'
source_issues.evidence: User reports runtime crash when combining Entity Framework with PgVector extension after upgrading Npgsql to 10.0.2. Reproducible with specific steps using AIWebChat project template.

signals.topic: Handoff orchestration fails to pass context between agents in multi-agent workflows
signals.summary: In multi-agent handoff orchestration workflows with unique kernel instances per agent, context from previous agents is not automatically passed to subsequent agents. This causes downstream agents to lack access to prior outputs, leading to hallucination and incomplete task execution.
signals.review_reason: Core orchestration feature failure that breaks expected multi-agent workflow behavior. Users cannot build working handoff chains without manual intervention, defeating the purpose of automated orchestration.

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Handoff Orchestration: Context not passed from previous agents
source_issues.evidence: User provides complete reproduction code showing A1->A2->A3 workflow where A2 lacks A1 output and A3 lacks both A1 and A2 outputs. Detailed console output screenshots demonstrate the issue.

signals.topic: MCP tool integration logging fails with NotSupportedException
signals.summary: When using Semantic Kernel with MCP servers via ModelContextProtocol.AspNet and enabling SK logging, users encounter NotImplementedException due to missing JsonTypeInfo metadata for Microsoft.Extensions.AI.TextContent type during serialization.
signals.review_reason: Logging failure affects observability but does not block core execution. User explicitly notes 'this is only on the logging side and has no effect on the execution.' Still a valid pain point for debugging and monitoring scenarios.

source_issues.title: Bug: NotImplementedException on SK Logging
source_issues.evidence: User provides full stack trace showing JsonTypeInfo serialization failure when logging function result values with MCP tools. Reproducible with specific steps using HttpTransport and AsKernelFunction extension.

signals.topic: VertexAI embedding dimensions parameter not respected
signals.summary: When using IEmbeddingGenerator with the dimensions attribute, VertexAI connector ignores the specified dimensions and returns the model's default dimensions (e.g., 3072 instead of requested 128). The Google Gemini connector works correctly but VertexAI does not.
signals.review_reason: Feature works in one connector (Google Gemini) but fails in another (VertexAI), causing inconsistent behavior and potential vector dimension mismatches in downstream applications.

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Embedding generation dimensions works in Google Gemini but fails in VertexAI

source_issues.title: Python: Bug: Python: Circular Reference Error when running Process samples with SEMANTICKERNEL_EXPERIMENTAL_GENAI_ENABLE_OTEL_DIAGNOSTICS_SENSITIVE=true
source_issues.evidence: User provides reproduction steps and error output showing circular reference errors in all Process sample variations when sensitive diagnostics are enabled.

signals.topic: bubblewrap sandbox fails with --argv0 on older Linux versions (Ubuntu 22.04, WSL2)
signals.summary: The built-in bubblewrap sandbox fails on systems with bwrap < 0.9.0 (like Ubuntu 22.04) due to unsupported --argv0 option, making all sandboxed commands fail with 'bwrap: Unknown option --argv0'. This completely blocks editing/execution in the extension and CLI.
signals.review_reason: Critical workflow blocker: users on Ubuntu 22.04 and WSL2 cannot use sandboxed commands at all. Both issues report identical root cause with clear user impact evidence (commands fail immediately, extension becomes unusable). Marked P1 instead of P0 because issues are closed (likely fixed), but significant impact merits tracking.

source_issues.title: {Bug}: built-in bubblewrap package failure
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'bwrap: Unknown option --argv0' error causing shell assisted file edit to fail. Persists through sessions on WSL2.

source_issues.title: VS Code extension 26.318.11754 fails on Ubuntu 22.04 with bubblewrap 0.6.1: bwrap: Unknown option --argv0
source_issues.evidence: Extension unusable - even trivial commands like 'pwd' fail. User had to rollback to previous version. bubblewrap 0.6.1 doesn't support --argv0 which was added in v0.9.0.

signals.topic: CLI/TUI freezes and becomes unresponsive
signals.summary: Codex CLI freezes or locks up during normal usage - 'waiting' state persists indefinitely, esc and new prompts don't help. Also freezes occur during context compacting operations.
signals.review_reason: High-impact workflow blocker: users cannot continue work when CLI freezes. Both issues show complete workflow interruption requiring session restart. Clear evidence of user impact from multiple users.

source_issues.title: codex cli locks up

source_issues.title: Freeze on context compact

signals.topic: Non-ASCII and symlinked workspace paths break reconnect/thread visibility
signals.summary: Workspace paths containing non-ASCII characters (Cyrillic) cause UTF-8 decode failures during streaming reconnect. Symlinked workspace paths cause thread history to disappear due to path canonicalization mismatch.

source_issues.title: x-codex-turn-metadata UTF-8 decode failure on reconnect when workspace path contains Cyrillic characters
source_issues.evidence: User reports repeated 'Reconnecting...' with UTF-8 encoding error for x-codex-turn-metadata header when workspace path contains Cyrillic characters. Streamed response does not recover cleanly.

source_issues.title: Codex App hides existing threads when a project is reopened via a symlinked workspace path on macOS
source_issues.evidence: User reports thread history disappears when reopening project via symlink. Detailed investigation shows path canonicalization mismatch between workspace root (symlink) and thread cwd (real path).

signals.topic: Non-interactive authentication breaks automated deployment pipelines
signals.summary: OAuth token registration requires interactive TTY, making it impossible to provision Codex CLI in automated deployment scenarios (SSH without TTY allocation). No --non-interactive flag or environment variable option available.
signals.review_reason: Blocks key enterprise/devops use case: automated provisioning is impossible without workarounds. User provides detailed reproduction steps and explicit use case (deployment CLI for cloud instances).

source_issues.title: OAuth token registration fails during automated provisioning — requires manual registration on instance
source_issues.evidence: User attempting automated cloud instance provisioning with Codex pre-installed. Auth command hangs or silently fails in non-interactive SSH. Manual intervention required, breaking fully automated deployments.

signals.topic: --json and --output-schema silently ignored when tools/MCP servers are active
signals.summary: When using --json flag with --output-schema alongside MCP servers or tools, the structured output constraint is silently ignored. Returns malformed YAML-like output instead of valid JSON, breaking automated agentic workflows.
signals.review_reason: Breaks programmatic usage: users relying on structured output for automation get invalid output without any warning. Clear evidence with repro steps and explicit impact statement from user.

source_issues.title: [Bug] --json and --output-schema are silently ignored when tools/MCP servers are active, resulting in malformed outputs
source_issues.evidence: User provides exact reproduction steps with schema.json. Output is missing outer braces and commas - malformed instead of strict JSON. User explicitly states this 'severely breaks automated agentic workflows'.

signals.topic: Reasoning model items incompatible with non-reasoning models in handoffs
signals.summary: When agents using reasoning models (o4-mini, gpt-5.4) hand off to agents using general models (gpt-4.1), the reasoning items in the input list cause 400 API errors because the API rejects reasoning input items for non-reasoning models

source_issues.evidence: Compaction with gpt-5.4 reasoning causes 400 error because compacted output retains orphaned assistant message IDs that imply required paired reasoning items

signals.topic: Handoff input filters break server-managed conversations
signals.summary: Using handoff input filters like remove_all_tools or nest_handoff_history with conversation_id/previous_response_id causes 400 errors or incorrect behavior because the SDK modifies local history without updating server-side state
signals.review_reason: Users combining handoffs with server-managed conversations get API errors or silently incorrect behavior, blocking a common production pattern

source_issues.title: nest handoff: Handoff is incompatible with server-managed conversation
source_issues.evidence: remove_all_tools causes 'No tool output found for function call' 400 error; nest_handoff_history produces incorrect results with conversation_id because server-side history is not modified

signals.topic: Traces silently dropped in long-running workers
signals.summary: BatchTraceProcessor only flushes on process shutdown or buffer full, so traces never appear on dashboard in Celery/FastAPI background tasks unless users manually call force_flush()
signals.review_reason: Production users lose all observability in common worker deployments with no error or warning, causing significant debugging pain

source_issues.title: Traces are silently dropped in long-running workers
source_issues.evidence: Traces created in Celery/FastAPI background tasks never appear on platform.openai.com/traces because buffer never flushes; requires manual force_flush() call that is undocumented

signals.topic: Concurrent session writes fail and drop data
signals.summary: SQLAlchemySession has race conditions in table creation and session row insertion that cause OperationalError, IntegrityError, and silent data loss when multiple tasks write to the same fresh session concurrently
signals.review_reason: Concurrent access causes database errors and silent message loss, corrupting session history in production workloads

source_issues.title: SQLAlchemySession can fail and drop writes on concurrent first access
source_issues.evidence: Concurrent writes to fresh SQLAlchemySession cause 'table already exists' errors, UNIQUE constraint failures, and stored item count well below submitted writes

signals.topic: Parallel tool calls crash with asyncio.eager_task_factory
signals.summary: _FunctionToolBatchExecutor has a race condition where task lookup via current_task() fails with KeyError when using asyncio.eager_task_factory (Python 3.12+, Textual apps), causing streamed runs with parallel tool calls to crash
signals.review_reason: Runtime crash in specific async contexts (Textual apps, Python 3.12+) blocks parallel tool execution entirely; requires downgrade or workarounds

source_issues.title: Regression in 0.12.5: KeyError in _FunctionToolBatchExecutor under asyncio.eager_task_factory
source_issues.evidence: KeyError crash in task_states lookup during parallel tool calls; detailed root cause analysis shows task registration race with eager task factory

signals.topic: Batch API 大文件下载失败 (>200MB)
signals.summary: 使用 Batch API 下载大型结果文件（如 50k embedding 请求产生的 >200MB 文件）时，连接被服务端提前关闭，导致下载失败
signals.review_reason: 用户在进行大规模 Batch 操作时无法获取结果，主流程被阻断。虽然有拆分批次的变通方案，但增加了用户负担且不符合预期的 SDK 行为

source_issues.title: bug: Batch API result file download fails for large outputs (>200MB) with ConnectionResetError

signals.topic: prompt_cache_retention SDK 类型定义与 API 不一致
signals.summary: SDK 将 prompt_cache_retention 类型定义为 Literal["in-memory", "24h"]（连字符），但 API 实际只接受 "in_memory"（下划线），使用 SDK 提供的类型值会导致 400 错误
signals.review_reason: 用户按照 SDK 类型定义使用 API 时会遭遇意外失败，需要绕过类型系统才能正常工作，造成开发者困惑和调试成本

source_issues.title: `prompt_cache_retention` type declares `"in-memory"` but API expects `"in_memory"`
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了完整复现脚本，证明使用 SDK 定义的 "in-memory" 会返回 400 Bad Request，必须使用 type: ignore 绕过类型检查才能正常工作

signals.topic: 空 OPENAI_BASE_URL 环境变量阻止默认端点回退

signals.review_reason: 属于边缘配置场景，但当用户错误设置空环境变量时会产生难以理解的连接错误，错误信息不清晰

source_issues.title: Empty OPENAI_BASE_URL prevents fallback to default API endpoint
source_issues.evidence: 用户复现了 export OPENAI_BASE_URL="" 后 client.models.list() 返回 APIConnectionError 的问题

signals.topic: Control UI model selector sends incorrect provider prefix
signals.summary: Desktop Control UI model dropdown generates incorrect model identifiers - prepends 'anthropic/' to all models regardless of provider, or uses wrong provider prefix (e.g., 'ollama/' instead of 'ollama-remote/'), causing sessions.patch to fail with 'model not allowed' errors
signals.review_reason: 用户在 Control UI 选择模型后无法正常使用，主流程阻断。涉及多提供商配置场景，配置正确但 UI 发送错误 ID 导致请求失败

signals.topic: ACP sessions silently fail or are killed without completion events
signals.summary: ACP sessions spawned via sessions_spawn(runtime='acp') die silently without emitting error or completion events back to parent session. Also killed by gateway restart (SIGUSR1), losing all work in progress
signals.review_reason: 长时间运行的 ACP 任务静默失败或被终止，父会话无法感知，用户工作丢失且无通知

signals.topic: WhatsApp messages arrive as [object Object] instead of text
signals.summary: WhatsApp messages intermittently arrive to the LLM as '[object Object]' instead of actual text because sanitizeChatSendMessageInput() receives a JS object from Baileys instead of a string, with no type guard
signals.review_reason: WhatsApp 用户发送的消息被解析为 [object Object]，LLM 无法理解用户输入，导致所有对话失败

signals.topic: WhatsApp sessions not loaded as active after gateway restart

signals.review_reason: Gateway 重启后 WhatsApp 无法发送消息，影响生产环境的可靠性。用户需要手动重新登录才能恢复

source_issues.title: Gateway WebSocket rejects all inbound client connections with handshake timeout (2026.3.13)

signals.summary: Non-relative glob patterns raise NotImplementedError on Windows, causing unhandled exceptions when users try to add files or use read-only mode.

signals.review_reason: Causes runtime crash during active coding session on Windows. The error occurs during normal output display, interrupting user workflow. Single report but reproducible Windows-specific issue.

source_issues.title: Uncaught UnicodeEncodeError in cp1252.py line 19
source_issues.evidence: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u2588' - crashes when trying to display output with block characters on Windows cp1252 console

signals.summary: TypeError during analytics.event() call at startup - Client.capture() receives multiple values for 'distinct_id' argument, preventing aider from launching.

signals.topic: Model naming confusion when selecting models via /model command
signals.summary: Model list shows vendor-mimicking names that make it hard to distinguish official Anthropic models from Bedrock/Azure hosted versions.
signals.review_reason: UX friction during model selection - users may accidentally select wrong provider causing unexpected behavior/costs. Not a crash but impacts workflow decision-making.

source_issues.title: Deceiving Model Naming Convention
source_issues.evidence: User reports difficulty distinguishing official Anthropic models from Bedrock/Azure hosted versions when using /model command

signals.summary: Users cannot use OpenClaw provider with local agents - requests fail with 'missing scope: operator.write' error due to promptfoo not including paired device identity in connection
signals.review_reason: User explicitly reports integration failure - OpenClaw provider cannot connect and complete agent/session write operations, blocking the entire workflow for users trying to use OpenClaw agents

source_issues.title: Openclaw provider fails in openclaw:agent:agentid
source_issues.evidence: promptfoo eval fails with: OpenClaw agent error: missing scope: operator.write - agent/session write operations blocked

signals.summary: Users cannot run redteam scans with jailbreak:hydra strategy when OPENAI_API_KEY is set - error forces users to unset env var or use Promptfoo Cloud
