source_issues.evidence: Error: jailbreak:hydra strategy requires remote generation, which is currently disabled (commonly because OPENAI_API_KEY is set)

signals.topic: Azure OpenAI reasoning/verbosity config silently ignored with custom deployment names
signals.summary: When using openai:responses with Azure apiBaseUrl and custom deployment names, reasoning.effort and verbosity parameters are silently dropped because model name detection fails
signals.review_reason: Config silently fails - user explicitly sets reasoning and verbosity but they are dropped without warning, causing unexpected behavior in model responses

source_issues.title: openai:responses with Azure apiBaseUrl: reasoning/verbosity not sent for custom deployment names
source_issues.evidence: Verified via LOG_LEVEL=debug - request body contains no reasoning or verbosity fields when using Azure deployment names like 'my-company-gpt-54-prod'

signals.topic: config.cost override applies identical rate to input/output tokens
signals.summary: Single config.cost value is used for both input and output token pricing, causing cost reports to be inaccurate for models with asymmetric pricing (up to 4x difference)
signals.review_reason: Cost reporting feature produces significantly incorrect results - users relying on cost tracking get inaccurate data, directly affecting business decisions and budget tracking

source_issues.title: bug: config.cost override applies identical rate to both input and output token pricing
source_issues.evidence: For GPT-4o: correct cost $0.0125 vs buggy cost $0.01 for 1000 input + 1000 output tokens - 25% error due to ignoring asymmetric pricing

signals.topic: LLM provider integration failures (Ollama client config ignored, vLLM field deprecation, Cerebras version conflict)
signals.summary: Users experience broken integrations with LLM providers: Ollama ignores client initialization parameters (authentication headers), vLLM deprecated 'reasoning_content' field causes failures when extracting thinking content, and llama-index core version conflicts with Cerebras integration causing installation failures.
signals.review_reason: Three distinct integration failures that block users from using their preferred LLM providers. Each case represents a complete workflow blockage where the user cannot proceed with their intended use case.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Ollama does not respect the client's initialization
source_issues.evidence: User cannot use Ollama with custom API key authentication because kwargs are ignored. User had to pass host twice and still couldn't get auth headers working.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: reasoning_content is deprecated in vLLM, cannot get thinking content through openai API
source_issues.evidence: User cannot extract thinking content from Qwen3.5 model deployed via vLLM because the library still tries to access deprecated 'reasoning_content' field.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: llama-index 0.14.18 incompatible with llama-index-llms-cerebras
source_issues.evidence: User cannot install llama-index with cerebras integration due to dependency version conflicts - 'No solution found when resolving dependencies'

signals.topic: VectorStore delete operations crash or use wrong APIs
signals.summary: VectorStoreIndex and DocumentSummaryIndex delete operations have critical bugs: DocumentSummaryIndex.delete_nodes() crashes with KeyError on invalid node IDs, and VectorStoreIndex delete helpers call wrong delete API (ref-doc API with node ID) and use sync calls in async paths.
signals.review_reason: Two bugs in core delete functionality that cause crashes or incorrect behavior. Users cannot reliably delete nodes from their indexes, which is a common operation in production RAG systems.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: DocumentSummaryIndex.delete_nodes() crashes on invalid node IDs instead of skipping them
source_issues.evidence: delete_nodes() raises KeyError when encountering invalid node IDs because it mutates a list during iteration which skips elements, causing remaining invalid IDs to trigger dict lookup errors.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: VectorStoreIndex delete helpers use a wrong delete API and sync call in async path
source_issues.evidence: _adelete_from_index_struct() makes synchronous delete calls instead of using async path, and passes node IDs to ref-doc deletion API which is semantically incorrect.

signals.topic: CondensePlusContextChatEngine silently returns 'Empty Response' when retriever finds no nodes
signals.summary: When using CondensePlusContextChatEngine with async streaming (astream_chat), if the retriever returns 0 nodes (common with metadata filters like tenant IDs), the engine silently aborts LLM generation and returns hardcoded 'Empty Response' instead of proceeding with empty context.
signals.review_reason: Critical bug for production multi-tenant RAG systems. The silent abort behavior means users get no meaningful response when their query doesn't match indexed content, even though the LLM could still answer general questions.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: CondensePlusContextChatEngine.astream_chat silently aborts generation and yields 'Empty Response' when Retriever returns 0 nodes
source_issues.evidence: User reports that the chat engine skips LLM API call entirely and returns 'Empty Response' when retriever returns 0 nodes. This breaks production multi-tenant RAG systems where users ask general questions that may not match indexed content.

signals.topic: SimplePropertyGraphStore fails to persist UTF-8 characters on Windows
signals.summary: SimplePropertyGraphStore.persist() doesn't specify UTF-8 encoding when writing files, causing UnicodeEncodeError on Windows where the default encoding is cp1252. Users working with non-ASCII content (e.g., Chinese characters, OCR output) cannot persist their knowledge graphs.
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow blockage for Windows users working with non-ASCII content. The user cannot save their work without monkey-patching the library, which is not acceptable for production use.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: SimplePropertyGraphStore can't persist utf-8 encoded chars on Windows
source_issues.evidence: User got UnicodeEncodeError when trying to persist a knowledge graph containing Chinese characters. The root cause is that persist() doesn't specify encoding, so Windows uses cp1252 instead of UTF-8. User had to monkey-patch to work around it.

signals.topic: LlamaCloud API v2 extract endpoint returns 422/500 errors with documented field names
signals.summary: The LlamaCloud v2 extract API endpoint rejects requests using field names (type/value) documented in the API reference with 422 errors. Using the suggested field names (document_input_type/document_input_value) results in 500 server errors. Users cannot use the v2 extract endpoint at all.
signals.review_reason: Complete API endpoint failure - users cannot use the documented v2 extract API at all. Documentation does not match actual API behavior, and both documented and suggested field names result in errors.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LlamaCloud `POST /api/v2/extract` — 422 with documented field names, 500 with actual field names
source_issues.evidence: User reports that the API reference documents type/value fields but the API rejects them with 422. Using the field names suggested in validation errors results in 500 server errors. The v1 workflow works fine with same documents.

signals.topic: Swarm/Hive-mind orchestration non-functional - no execution engine
signals.summary: v3 rewrite replaced the execution engine (SwarmOrchestrator + subprocess management) with flat JSON CRUD. MCP tools create agent/task records but nothing consumes them to dispatch actual work. Agents spawn successfully but never execute tasks, status always shows idle, workers never run.
signals.review_reason: Core product feature (swarm/hive-mind orchestration) is completely non-functional. Users cannot get agents to execute any work. Multiple users have extensively tested and documented 100% failure rates. This blocks the primary use case of the product.

source_issues.title: Swarm agents still do not execute work — v3.5.42 (@claude-flow/cli@latest)
source_issues.evidence: 68 worker executions tested, 100% failure rate. Agents spawn but never execute work. Test showed 0 active agents, 0 tasks, 0 tokens used. hello.txt never created.

source_issues.title: Hive-mind worker tracking is non-functional: task lifecycle never syncs agent state
source_issues.evidence: task_assign writes to tasks/store.json but never updates agents.json. Workers stay idle forever, Completed column always shows 0. Queen load is Math.random().

source_issues.title: v3 regression: hive-mind_status hardcodes all workers as idle
source_issues.evidence: Status handler hardcodes status:'idle', currentTask:null, tasksCompleted:0 instead of reading from agent store. Every user sees workers as idle even when actively working.

source_issues.title: hive-mind spawn --claude prompt hardcodes wrong MCP tool prefix
source_issues.evidence: Prompt contains 25 hardcoded references to mcp__claude-flow__* tools but MCP server exposes mcp__ruflo__*. Spawned agents try to call tools that don't exist.

signals.topic: Memory storage and AgentDB bridge failures
signals.summary: Multiple memory system failures: AgentDB tools return 'Bridge not available' due to CLI bundling outdated memory package. MCP memory_store tool fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined'. Memory features partially or completely broken for users.
signals.review_reason: Core memory features (AgentDB and MCP memory_store) are broken, preventing users from using persistent memory capabilities. While CLI workaround exists for one issue, AgentDB is completely non-functional and blocks hierarchical recall and pattern search use cases.

source_issues.title: AgentDB bridge unavailable — CLI bundles old memory package
source_issues.evidence: All agentdb_* MCP tools return {available:false, error:'Bridge not available'}. CLI bundles @claude-flow/memory@alpha.11 which doesn't export ControllerRegistry.

source_issues.title: memory_store MCP tool fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined'
source_issues.evidence: memory_store MCP tool returns {success:false, error:'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'}. CLI workaround exists but MCP interface broken.

signals.topic: Headless workers hang forever causing kernel panic and memory exhaustion
signals.summary: stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'] opens stdin but never closes it. Claude Code blocks waiting for EOF until SIGTERM timeout fires. Combined with daemons that never terminate across sessions, this causes unbounded memory growth leading to kernel panic (71GB RSS on 36GB machine).
signals.review_reason: Critical system stability issue causing complete machine failure (kernel panic). Users running multiple projects experience uncontrolled memory consumption leading to system crashes. The bug has severe real-world impact documented with specific evidence.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Workers always fail (stdin never closed) + daemons never terminate = kernel panic at scale

signals.topic: Intelligence layer loads only 1 pattern instead of 1,300+

signals.topic: Tool input validation errors permanently break conversations
signals.summary: When LLMs generate tool calls with invalid JSON input, the AI SDK creates error state parts but subsequently re-validates them on every turn, causing unrecoverable TypeValidationErrors or 400 errors that brick entire conversations permanently.
signals.review_reason: Direct user impact: conversations become permanently unusable after a single malformed tool call. Multiple reports with reproduction steps. High frequency issue affecting any user with complex tool schemas.

source_issues.title: validateUIMessages re-validates input on output-error tool parts, bricking conversations

signals.topic: Streaming failures in React Native and concurrent tool execution

source_issues.title: Race condition in attemptClose causes 'stream is not in a state that permits enqueue'
source_issues.evidence: Detailed root cause analysis provided. Error intermittent but timing-dependent. Affects Convex V8 isolates and environments with different microtask scheduling.

source_issues.title: Streaming gives error in client side expo React Native

signals.topic: Tool approval workflow stalls when user denies tool call

signals.review_reason: Blocks usage of popular OpenAI-compatible backends (Ollama, LM Studio) with reasoning models. Affects generate and stream flows. Reproduction provided.

source_issues.title: openai-compatible: chat content arrays with thinking parts fail validation
source_issues.evidence: Breaks both generate and stream flows for OpenAI-compatible providers. Example stream chunk provided showing valid content array format that gets rejected.

signals.topic: Vercel production deployment failures in Next.js 16.2 (multiple root causes)
signals.summary: Next.js 16.2 引入了多个导致 Vercel 生产部署完全失败的回归问题，包括：ESM 模块加载失败、WASM 文件 404、proxy matcher 规则失效、Bun 运行时被强制覆盖为 Node.js。这些问题导致应用在生产环境无法正常运行。
signals.review_reason: 高频(count=4)生产部署阻断问题，涉及多个独立根因，全部导致生产环境不可用。这是版本升级后的严重回归。

source_issues.title: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM regression in 16.2.0 for apps with "type": "module" deployed to Vercel
source_issues.evidence: All routes fail at runtime with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. Apps with 'type': 'module' in package.json cannot deploy. Pinning to 16.1.7 is the only workaround.

source_issues.title: Turbopack: WASM fetch URLs break on Vercel due to double-encoded ?dpl= deployment suffix
source_issues.evidence: WASM file requests return 404 due to double URL encoding. Browser requests .wasm%3Fdpl%3Ddpl_xxx?dpl=dpl_xxx instead of correct path. Production broken for WASM apps.

source_issues.title: 16.2.0 Regression: proxy not following matcher rule on Vercel
source_issues.evidence: Proxy matcher rules are ignored on Vercel for built-ins like sitemap.ts and robots.txt. Works correctly on local dev and on 16.1.7 on Vercel.

source_issues.title: Next.js 16.2.0 regression: bunVersion ignored, all functions forced to Node.js on Vercel
source_issues.evidence: All Vercel functions run on Node.js despite bunVersion: '1.x' in vercel.json. The adapter-vercel pipeline writes per-function configs that override project-level bunVersion. Only downgrade to 16.1.7 fixes it.

signals.topic: Turbopack HMR stops working for dynamically imported JSON files after first edit (16.2 regression)
signals.summary: 在 Next.js 16.2 中，通过动态 import() 加载的 JSON 文件（如 next-intl 的翻译文件）仅在首次编辑时触发 HMR，后续编辑被静默忽略，必须重启开发服务器才能看到更改。严重影响使用 next-intl 等国际化方案的开发者工作流。
signals.review_reason: 高频(count=3)回归问题，完全阻断使用动态 JSON 导入的开发者工作流，每次修改需重启服务器，严重影响开发效率。

source_issues.title: Turbopack HMR stops working after first edit for dynamically imported JSON files (16.2 regression)
source_issues.evidence: Only the first edit to a JSON file loaded via dynamic import() with a template literal triggers HMR. All subsequent edits are silently ignored until the dev server is restarted. Affects next-intl pattern import(`../../messages/${locale}.json`).

source_issues.title: JSON files loaded via dynamic import() no longer trigger HMR after upgrading to 16.2
source_issues.evidence: Editing a JSON translation file does not trigger HMR. A full server restart is required. Regression from 16.1.x to 16.2.0.

source_issues.title: JSON files loaded via dynamic import() no longer trigger HMR after upgrading to 16.2
source_issues.evidence: Dynamic import() with template literal paths may not be tracked as a dependency, so dependents are not invalidated when the JSON file changes.

signals.topic: SWC 56 skips React Compiler for TypeScript files with bare generic arrow functions
signals.summary: SWC 56 升级后错误地将 TypeScript 文件中的泛型箭头函数（如 `<T>`）解析为 JSX，导致整个文件被跳过 React Compiler 处理。所有 hooks 静默失去 memoization，性能下降且难以察觉。
signals.review_reason: 静默失败问题，hooks 失去 memoization 但不报错，用户难以察觉，影响性能。有明确的版本回归定位和 workaround。

source_issues.title: SWC 56 skips React Compiler for .ts files with bare generic arrow functions
source_issues.evidence: SWC 56's isReactCompilerRequired() misidentifies bare <T> in .ts files as JSX, causing the entire file to be skipped from React Compiler processing. All hooks silently lose memoization.

source_issues.title: SWC 56 skips React Compiler for .ts files with bare generic arrow functions
source_issues.evidence: Regression introduced by SWC 56 upgrade (PR #89111). const useMyHook = <T>(initialValue: T) is not compiled - no compiler-runtime import, no memo cache.

signals.review_reason: 新项目开箱即失败，create-next-app 的默认脚手架与同版本新特性不兼容，且错误信息不明确导致排查困难。

source_issues.evidence: After changing .pnp.cjs, the build output still contains old dependency version. Persistent cache is not invalidated when .pnp.cjs changes. Configuration mismatch between webpack and rspack.
